changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration.katm_setting ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, base_url TEXT NOT NULL, login TEXT NOT NULL, password TEXT, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration.katm_report ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, user_id UUID, pinfl TEXT, p_client_id TEXT, p_claim_id TEXT, p_token TEXT, language TEXT, status TEXT, amount NUMERIC, is_free BOOLEAN, result_message TEXT, report_base64 TEXT, request JSONB, response JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMP, completed_at TIMESTAMP );
